visual_action: Donald Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan walk together on an airport tarmac. Erdoğan has his hand on Trump's back and arm as they walk, at one point gesturing forward with his other hand. The clip appears to be in slow motion.

cultural_references: The skull emoji (💀) used as internet slang to signify extreme amusement or something being 'dead' funny.
central_claim: Donald Trump is physically frail and needs assistance from another world leader to walk properly.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump and portray him as physically unfit or weak.
